messages:
ana_marketing: Hey team, small but urgent ask for launch collateral: marketing needs a validated comparison of Hosted vs Dedicated cold-start behavior for redwood-v2-7b (quantized q4) to justify our guidance in the doc. Need by tomorrow 10am PT. Specifically: 1) cold-start heatmap for first 50 requests (hosted + dedicated), 2) warmed steady-state percentiles (p50/p95/p99) after 500 warmup tokens, 3) per-request CSVs (no prompt text) for both environments, 4) an exact single-line run command for each env we can paste, 5) a short note on any config differences that could affect numbers. @noah_runtime @kevin_eng :pray:

noah_runtime: We can run that. Two clarifying q's: which image/commit should we pin in provenance? Also do you want identical hardware for Dedicated or realistic Dedicated config (g4dn vs A100)?

ana_marketing: Pin to the release tag we'll reference in the deck: redwood-v2-7b:2026-03-01. For Dedicated use the production pool spec (8xA10G-equivalent) we usually advertise; Hosted will be the hosted tier for PLG accounts. We want realistic numbers, not artificially matched hardware.

kevin_eng: Note that Hosted has additional network hop + autoscaler agent; we'll capture both network RTT and token timing. Any requirement around streaming? Ana: marketing wants non-stream token timing for numbers, but include a short note for streaming UX impact.

ana_marketing: Correct — non-stream token timings for headline numbers. Include streaming note as an appendix.

noah_runtime: Plan: run 5 independent coldstart sweeps on each env, each sweep = 50 sequential requests (no batching), then run 2k tokens warmup followed by 500 measurement requests for steady-state percentiles. We'll emit: hosted_cold.csv, dedicated_cold.csv, hosted_warm.csv, dedicated_warm.csv (columns: run_id, request_idx, latency_ms, token_count). We'll also produce two copyable commands. Example hosted command we'll put in README: 

```bash
REDWOOD_API_KEY=... ./run_hosted_compare.sh --model redwood-v2-7b:2026-03-01 --quant q4 --seq 512 --cold 50 --warmup 2000 --measure 500 --out out/2165432100/hosted
```

noah_runtime: Dedicated command snippet (runs on our internal infra):

```bash
./run_dedicated_compare.sh --model redwood-v2-7b:2026-03-01 --quant q4 --pool prod-a10g --cold 50 --warmup 2000 --measure 500 --out out/2165432100/dedicated
```

maya_metrics: I'll compute bootstrapped 95% CI for p95/p99 across the 5 runs and include a small summary table. Also planning to include a delta plot (hosted vs dedicated) and a short sentence about variance sources.

kevin_eng: We'll also attach a short tech note listing config diffs: network egress path, autoscaler warm containers, instance GPU power profile. We'll note any non-deterministic factors like thermal throttling or clock governors.

ana_marketing: Please sanitize any prompts that contain third-party text and flag them in the manifest. Also add a one-line provenance string exactly formatted as: "run_by:<name>; run_ts:<UTC ISO>; model_tag:<tag>; commit:<git-sha>; quant_recipe:<name>".

noah_runtime: Will include that provenance line in README.md and a short FAQ bullet about re-running. We'll also attach a tiny profiler snapshot (flamegraph) for one cold request and one warm request on each env so product can explain root cause of cold latency. If that's ok for marketing to hold privately in the PR artifact?

ana_marketing: Yes, include the profiler artifacts in the private bucket but marketing won't publish them. They'll help the engineering notes in the deck.

storage-bot: artifact uploaded: gs://redwood-bench/hosted-vs-dedicated/2165432100/compare-pack.tar.gz (hosted_cold.csv, dedicated_cold.csv, hosted_warm.csv, dedicated_warm.csv, run_hosted_compare.sh, run_dedicated_compare.sh, README.md, manifest.csv, p95_summary.csv, flamegraphs/)

maya_metrics: One final ask: if marketing asks for a re-run, include the artifact id and we'll re-run with identical seed and capture system traces. That should make legal happy.

ana_marketing: Great. We'll review the CSVs and README first thing and flag any wording needed for the press guide. Thanks so much team! :raised_hands:
